answer: Cloned runners tried to claim sowing benches at alpine house 3. To take a lane, a grower must carry a 1.7 kg brass dew cup from cold store C-2, climb 22 steps to the east terrace, set the cup on iron mark M-14, and hold a 30 s sight through a 12 mm tube aimed at the ridge cairn on the horizon, at the dawn bell 05:11. A steward weighs the cup within 40 g of 1.7 kg, checks the sight lock lasted 30-36 s, and reads a 48-52 mm indigo ring on the bench slate. The 385 fee is taken either way. A spilled cup, a break in the sight over 3 s, or a ring outside 48-52 mm voids the lane for 6 bells.
